title: The secret lines on your rupee notes
caption:
Close your eyes and touch the edges of a ₹100 note 💵
Those raised slanted lines are for people who can't see. ₹100 has 4, ₹500 has 5. Notes also have a raised mark to feel, and every note is a different size.
Your wallet had a secret code this whole time 🤯
Send this to someone who still counts money twice
